title: Tebo's Corruption Mod
description: This mod adds a few blocks (or more in later updates) that spread to other blocks, slowly infecting your world. This could be fun to play with if you want to try to escape the corruption.
body: This mod adds a few blocks (or more in later updates) that spread to other blocks, slowly infecting your world. This could be fun to play with if you want to try to escape the corruption. The blocks are only obtainable in Creative Mode, the corruption cannot be stopped once it is placed. Be warned, this may lag your world.
